selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection found that repositoryPathIndex already excluded credential-like path hints, but NorthStarRunner's initial semantic-context seed and federated needs_more_context recovery both ultimately call WorkspaceService.contextBundle, which still read credential-like paths directly. contextBundle also followed in-workspace final symlinks and symlink ancestors, so a benign-looking alias could inject sensitive referent content into model/cognition context. This contradicted the repository's stated credential-exclusion contract and the user's sovereignty boundary.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router's singular evidence-rich bottleneck gate selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT because centrality and evidence density exceed the deterministic deep-development thresholds; no mode rotation was forced.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. The committed DWAC North Star scoring and four-mode routing source contracts were replayed against fresh canonical code evidence after the hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.direct_credential_request: EXPECTED FAILURE reproduced on canonical base: WorkspaceService.contextBundle(['.env','safe.txt']) returned the .env content, including a synthetic API_KEY value.
pre_fix_reproduction.symlink_alias_request: EXPECTED FAILURE reproduced on canonical base: a benign notes.txt symlink to .env was followed and its synthetic secret content entered the context bundle.
pre_fix_reproduction.policy_mismatch: repositoryPathIndex excluded credential-like hints while contextBundle, the actual content-reading boundary used by semantic seeding and needs_more_context, did not enforce the same policy.

changes: core/repo-context.mjs now exports one reusable isCredentialLikePath classifier and applies it consistently to selectContextPaths, repositoryPathIndex and repositorySummary top-level hints.
WorkspaceService.contextBundle now rejects credential-like requested paths before reading content.
contextBundle now uses lstat for the final requested object and refuses final symlinks, preventing benign-name aliases from being followed into another file.
contextBundle reuses the freshly closed ancestorState boundary so in-workspace symlink ancestors are also refused before content loading.
Direct WorkspaceService.read/readBytes APIs remain unchanged; this patch narrows the cognition/model context assembly boundary rather than forbidding explicit user-driven file access.
truth_boundaries: This closes direct credential-like path requests and filesystem symlink aliasing at the model/cognition contextBundle boundary. It does not claim content-based secret detection inside otherwise benign regular files.
Hard-link aliases are not distinguished from ordinary regular files by this patch.
Direct explicit WorkspaceService.read/readBytes access is unchanged; the protected boundary is automatic context assembly.
Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis remains UNRESOLVED, and filesystem crash-level atomicity remains unresolved.
No new product form, feature roadmap, provider architecture or hard-coded task-to-mode mapping was introduced.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
